svg.text: PE2 QSPI1_IO (shares CN9 pin 14) | PE12 TIM1_CH3N
CN1 Micro-USB: PRIMARY DEV PORT -- SWD + VCP debug, 5V_USB_STLK power in
flash + attach: mise run flash nucleo-h753zi
JP1 OFF, JP2 [1-2], JP3/JP4 ON, JP5 [1-2]
Debug hookup: CN1 alone carries SWD and the VCP (USART3, sect. 7.6.5); CN5 MIPI-10 takes an external probe.
Zio header data: UM2407 Rev 6 Tables 18-21. CN7/CN10 (right) carry the digital/QSPI/TIM extension; CN8/CN9 (left)
carry power + SDMMC and A0-A5/CAN. Morpho CN11/CN12: Table 22, both fully populated (no unfitted footprint).
